name: c01_city_quay
prompt: Strict first-person POV at eye height, looking straight ahead down the middle of a stone city quay beside a river at night in heavy rain, one-point perspective. On the left, old European apartment buildings with lit windows, a few parked bicycles and a closed café awning; on the right, the black river, and across it a dense city skyline with lit windows, church spires and a stone bridge with streetlights, all reflected in the water. The quay ahead is flooded with a shallow sheet of rippling water reflecting the warm streetlights. No hood, no body, no hands, no people. Realistic, cinematic 35mm, film grain.
